description: This file declares functions related to monitoring the health of a Zigbee network, including starting, stopping, and setting problem states. It serves as an interface for Zigbee health check operations within the project.

methods.name: zigbeeHealthCheckStart
methods.description: Initiates monitoring of the Zigbee network health.

methods.name: zigbeeHealthCheckStop
methods.description: Stops monitoring the Zigbee network health.

methods.name: zigbeeHealthCheckSetProblem
methods.description: Sets the health problem state of the Zigbee network.
